acceptanceCriteria: A perf-only contextindex change with byte-identical golden index output does not require a schema version bump
A change that alters index output still fails the check without a bump
body: Lane idxbuild-1021k (V1-2285) changed only build performance in internal/contextindex; built index content sha256 a5a31c34... identical before and after. TestAnalyzerSchemaInputs / script/analyzer-schema.sh still require a schema bump because every non-test .go file is an analyzer input. Parallel lanes then collide on the schema number (#1445 /137, #1458 /138, #1460 /139, V1-2285 next) and each bump invalidates cached indexes needlessly. Consider an output-equivalence escape (golden index digest unchanged => no bump) or narrowing inputs to output-affecting files.

title: contextindex: any non-test .go edit forces an analyzer schema bump even when built index content is byte-identical
